# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large batch of short, real phone-call fragments from Crayon Roofing & Structures (also heard as "Cryon Roofing and Structures" / "Rayan Roofing and Structure"), a JSW-linked colour-coated roofing sheet, polycarbonate sheet, and hardware (screws/welding consumables/pipes) trading business near Chennai/Chengalpattu. The majority of the audio is **not pure sales** — it is dispatch/loading coordination, driver/location directions, Porter/lorry booking, payment follow-up, and even unrelated spam (job-seeker Hindi caller, SRM college sponsorship ask, "Porter Goods Damage" fraud-sounding claim calls). Genuine sales content — rate enquiries, product/thickness/colour clarification, negotiation, and order confirmation — is scattered across dozens of short snippets rather than full structured sales calls. Because of this fragmentation, **this KB should be read as a set of patterns extracted from many partial calls, not a polished script**. Where quotes are used they are verbatim from the transcripts.

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on what sales calls actually discuss:

- **Colour-coated roofing sheets (GI/galvalume, profile & plain)** — brand ladder repeatedly named:
  - **JSW** (base brand) → **Coloron Plus** (main branded line, "15 years warranty") → **Silver-on Plus** / **Pragathi (Plus)** → **Radiance** (competitor-referenced) → **Kalaram/Kalyan Plus** → **Indradhanush / "Asian Dhanush"** (cheaper, non-JSW-brand alternative), e.g. *"JSW தான் இருக்குங்களா என்ன rate ஆகுது"* [Only JSW available? What rate?]
  - Thicknesses discussed: 0.40, 0.45, 0.47, 0.50, 0.60 mm.
  - Colours: Sky Blue, Off-white/Half White, Grey, Nova Blue, Royal Blue, "Caliph Field Green"/mixed green, Silver.
  - Plain (non-profile) GI/GP sheets also sold — *"கலாய் sheet-ன்னுவாங்க. G.P. G.I. sheet"*.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — Solid (clear, "கண்ணாடி மாதிரி") and Multi-wall, 5mm/6mm thickness, also a 2mm variant quoted at ₹800+GST/sq m. Clarified carefully on calls: *"Multi-wall-னா 6 mm. Solid-னா 5, 6, 4-லாம் கூட வரும்."*
- **Accessories / profile work**: Ridge sheets, L-Flash, trims, crimp sheets, purlins (MS), job-work "profile" bending service (billed separately from sheet, e.g. "L Flash-க்கு 1500 வராது… அதுக்கு 5000 வரும் accessories-க்கு").
- **Hardware**: Self-drilling screws (1 inch, 1.5 inch), Tata-brand welding electrodes/rods (sold by packet/cotton), cutting & grinding wheels.
- **Pipes**: MS pipe / CHS pipe enquiry (no PVC downpipe — *"PVC வராது Ma'am roofing sheet metal roofing sheet-ல பண்ணலாம்... GI-ல பண்ணி கொடுக்கலாம்"*).
- Misc/occasional: wall pass panel enquiry (unclear if stocked), welding rod coil (section-weight sensitive, 2.25–4 ton coils), Air Power item mentioned once (unclear SKU).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- Coloron Plus 0.47mm: **₹435 + GST per square meter** (quoted multiple times, also as "435*5" shorthand).
- Coloron Plus 0.50mm: **₹405–₹415 + GST per sq m** (price moved during the period — one call: *"₹410 சொன்னீங்க… rate ஏறிடுச்சு… ₹430 வருது"*).
- Coloron Plus in kg basis: **₹111–₹114 + tax/kg** at different points (price-revision discussion: *"August end-ல ஏத்திட்டாங்க"*).
- Pragathi / Pragathi Plus: **₹380–₹385/sq m**, or **₹102/kg** basis.
- Kalaram/Kalyan Plus: **₹420–₹425/sq m**, or **₹112–₹113/kg**.
- Indradhanush (cheap brand, 40/45 kg coil): **₹91–₹98/kg +tax**, moving up ~₹2–5 per call; running-meter weight ~3.6–3.9 kg/m.
- Polycarbonate solid 5mm: **"38×5" = ₹190 + GST per square foot**.
- Polycarbonate multi-wall 6mm: **₹32 + GST per square foot**.
- Polycarbonate 2mm (general sheet): **₹800 + GST per square meter**.
- Tata welding rod: **₹336/packet** (8 or 12 packets/cotton); also quoted **₹285+tax/packet → ₹332 with 2.5" size**; bulk discount past 10 cotton.
- L Flash / accessory job-work: roughly **₹5,000** vs plain sheet ~₹1,500 for small quantity — "sheet profile" is charged separately from job-work.
- SMP-coat tender business: **minimum order 5,000 sq m**, rate given only by "Sir"/management, not over phone directly.
- Daily **rate volatility is explicit and routine** — customers are repeatedly told *"இன்னைக்கு போட்டா மட்டும்தான் பழைய rate"* [old rate applies only if order is placed today] and *"kg-ல ₹1 ஏறி இருக்கு. square meter-ல ₹5 ஏறி இருக்கு."*
- Delivery/logistics cost is often passed through: Porter trips ₹2,500–₹3,500 for ~20km Chengalpattu-area delivery; unloading charges (₹200–₹250) sometimes disputed as extra cash to driver.

## Objection Playbook
1. **"Rate is more than before / competitor (Radiance/Tata) rate is cheaper"**
   - Response pattern: explain raw-material/coil price hikes are market-wide, not seller's choice — *"rate ஏறுறதும் ஏறி ஏறுறதும் அவர் இஷ்டத்துக்கு எல்லாம் ஏத்த முடியாது… market-ல rate ஏறுது"*.
   - Fallback: offer a small token discount (₹1–5/kg or /sq m) to save the deal, e.g. *"₹5 கம்மி பண்ணி குடுங்கன்னு கேட்டு கிடக்குறாரு"* and *"₹1 கம்மி பண்ணி குடுத்தாலும்… என்ன குடுக்குறதா கேளுங்க"*.
   - Always escalate pricing authority to "Sir"/MD/Yogesh before confirming — reps repeatedly say *"Sir கிட்ட கேட்டு தான் போடுவியா"*.

2. **"Old rate vs new rate confusion on same bill"**
   - Rule stated clearly: *"1 bill எப்பவுமே அந்த 2 rate கொடுக்காதீங்க, அது பிரச்சனையா இருக்கு"* — never mix two price points in one invoice; decide old or new before raising PO.

3. **Technical confusion (solid vs multi-wall polycarbonate, thickness mismatch)**
   - Agents patiently re-explain with numbers and offer to escalate to a "technical person" or send photos rather than argue: *"நான் இவரு technical person-ல line எடுக்கட்டுமா?"* and *"Photos already அனுப்பிச்சிருக்கேனே."*

4. **Stock unavailability / colour not in stock**
   - Be transparent, offer alternatives (different colour/brand) rather than overpromise: *"அதெல்லாம் இப்போ யார்கிட்டயும் stock இருக்காது… pre-order 100 tons… 45 days time எடுக்கும்."*
   - For urgent small quantities: *"டெலிவரி பீஸ்க்காக பண்ண மாட்டாங்க… bulk quantity இருந்தா தான் சார் ready பண்ணி தருவாங்க."*

5. **Delivery delay complaints**
   - Acknowledge honestly, give a concrete revised time, avoid vague promises: *"நான் ஒரு half an hour-ல call பண்றேன்… late பண்ணிட்டோம்னா மறுபடியும் ஏதாவது சொல்லுவாங்க."*
